title: ComfyUI backend datatypes
claim_support: Comfy datatypes act like strong typing on the client; IMAGE, LATENT, MASK, AUDIO, MODEL, CLIP, VAE, CONDITIONING and sampling datatypes are documented here.

title: ComfyUI Images, Latents, and Masks
claim_support: IMAGE is a torch tensor [B,H,W,C]; MASK is [B,H,W]; LATENT is a dict containing samples [B,C,H,W].

title: ComfyUI custom node properties
claim_support: Custom nodes use INPUT_TYPES, RETURN_TYPES, RETURN_NAMES, CATEGORY, FUNCTION, and functions must return tuples corresponding to RETURN_TYPES.

title: ComfyUI hidden and flexible inputs
claim_support: Hidden inputs can request UNIQUE_ID, PROMPT, and EXTRA_PNGINFO; flexible/custom input patterns should be treated carefully.

title: ComfyUI lazy evaluation
claim_support: Lazy inputs and check_lazy_status support conditional/router patterns without evaluating unused branches.

title: ComfyUI V3 migration and MultiType inputs
claim_support: V3 schema supports custom types, MultiType inputs, MatchType, dynamic inputs, and schema-based node definitions.
